title: Legion baseball: Strasburg tosses 1-hitter as Fort beats Hartland 4-0 - NewsBreak
text: HARTLAND — Jaren Strasburg pitched a one-hitter with four strikeouts as Fort Atkinson’s 19U American Legion Post 166 baseball team shut out host Hartland 4-0 on Tuesday. Strasburg allowed only a single to Jacob Lorbecki with one away in the first. Colton Herriot reached on an infield error next, before Strasburg got Brendan Foley and Will Nemecek to both fly out and end the threat. Strasburg retired eight straight hitters until Nemecek and Anderson King reached on consecutive infield errors with two outs in the fourth. After Brady Carpenter drew a walk, Strasburg got Logan Barke to pop out to second to end the frame. Strasburg retired 10 straight hitters to end it. He walked one and threw 84 pitches, including 55 strikes. Gavin Kanters led Fort offensively, going 2-for-4 out of the No. 3 spot in the order. Fort got on the board in the third. Braeden Hoth bunted for a hit to lead off the inning. Hoth was cut down trying to score from first on a fly ball single to left by Brogan Bosch, who took second on the throw. Bosch reached third on a passed ball before coming around on a ground out by Kanters. The Hawks (5-2-1), taking advantage of three straight two-out walks, pushed their lead to 3-0 when Hoth reached on shortstop Carter Scott’s error, bringing two runs home. Fort tacked on an insurance run via error in the seventh.
